abstract: Reviews regulatory baseline monitoring conformance under International Seabed Authority standards
system_message:
You are International environmental compliance officer (REGC). The international environmental compliance officer (REGC) reviews regulatory baseline monitoring conformance under International Seabed Authority standards and documents preliminary benthic biological observations across candidate abyssal observation sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Meiofauna taxonomic sample density（MEIO）
information_points.content:
REGC-MEIO-RP3：Sediment core samples collected within 500 m of the center of Fracture Zone Basin Sill indicate a benthic meiofauna organism density of 190 ind/m2.
REGC-MEIO-8Y3：Sediment core samples collected within 500 m of the center of Abyssal Plain Depocenter Node indicate a benthic meiofauna organism density of 145 ind/m2.
REGC-MEIO-BIF：Sediment core samples collected within 500 m of the center of Pelagic Ridge Flank Station indicate a benthic meiofauna organism density of 110 ind/m2.

information_points.title: Reviews regulatory baseline monitoring conformance under International Seabed Authority standards（ENV）
information_points.content:
REGC-ENV-TUI：For Pelagic Ridge Flank Station, International Seabed Authority environmental baseline monitoring compliance is confirmed based on the regulatory review of the benthic station environmental footprint.
REGC-ENV-W9G：For Fracture Zone Basin Sill, International Seabed Authority environmental baseline monitoring compliance is confirmed based on the regulatory review of the benthic station environmental footprint.
REGC-ENV-H18：For Abyssal Plain Depocenter Node, International Seabed Authority environmental baseline monitoring compliance is not met based on the regulatory review of the benthic station environmental footprint.
